data.notes: April 2026 mixed arena-scale Latin/pop and rock concerts with a strong electronic slate led by Sunsetstrip, Punta Carrasco and Groove club nights.

events.title: Emanero - Todo por un beso Tour 2026
events.summary: Emanero brought his Todo por un beso Tour 2026 to Movistar Arena, presenting his new conceptual album and a large-scale stage production.

events.title: Fito Páez - Sale el Sol Tour 2026
events.summary: Fito Páez returned to Buenos Aires with the Sale el Sol Tour 2026, combining career-defining songs with material from his recent album Novela.

events.title: Sunsetstrip Buenos Aires with Hernán Cattaneo
events.summary: Hernán Cattaneo's flagship Sunsetstrip event returned to Ciudad Universitaria for two sunset-focused electronic music dates.

events.title: Deckhaus presenta: Cassian
events.summary: Deckhaus hosted Australian DJ/producer Cassian at Punta Carrasco for a late-night melodic house and techno event.

events.title: Sebastián Yatra - Entre Tanta Gente Tour
events.summary: Sebastián Yatra brought the Latin American leg of his Entre Tanta Gente Tour to Movistar Arena in Buenos Aires.

events.title: Roxette
events.summary: Roxette's new-era live show came to Movistar Arena, with Per Gessle and Lena Philipsson performing the band's classic catalog.

events.title: Jorge Drexler - TARACÁ
events.summary: Jorge Drexler played two Movistar Arena dates presenting his album TARACÁ, with candombe-informed arrangements and a seven-musician band.

events.title: Dream Theater
events.summary: Progressive metal band Dream Theater played Movistar Arena in Buenos Aires, with Songkick listing the show for fans of metal and rock.

events.title: No Te Va a Gustar - Florece en el caos
events.summary: Uruguayan band No Te Va a Gustar presented Florece en el caos at Estadio Ferro Carril Oeste, launching an extensive Argentina and international tour cycle.

events.title: Utopic pres.: T78 3 HOURS, Kessler (AR) & ALYOSHA
events.summary: Utopic brought Italian techno artist T78 to Groove Palermo for a three-hour set with local support from Kessler (AR) and ALYOSHA.

events.title: The Lumineers - The Automatic Tour
events.summary: The Lumineers played Buenos Aires on The Automatic tour at Estadio Malvinas Argentinas in Paternal.

events.title: Paradoks & More Artists by DUSK & Deckhaus
events.summary: DUSK and Deckhaus closed April at Oasis, Punta Carrasco with Paradoks, BAEZ & SAINT and Maximiliano on a progressive house and techno bill.
